# Post Navigation Link

<!-- START TOKEN(Autogenerated block API docs) -->
**Name:** `core/post-navigation-link`
**Category:** [theme](/block-editor/reference-guides/core-blocks/core-blocks-theme/)
**API Version:** [3](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-api-versions/)
**Block Type:** [Dynamic](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/) (server-rendered)

> Displays the next or previous post link that is adjacent to the current post.

_Defined via the [`attributes`](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-attributes/) property in block.json._

|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `type` | `string` | `"next"` | — |
| `label` | `string` | — | [Role](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-attributes/#role): `content` |
| `showTitle` | `boolean` | `false` | — |
| `linkLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | — |
| `arrow` | `string` | `"none"` | — |
| `taxonomy` | `string` | `""` | — |

## Context

_Defined via the [`usesContext` and `providesContext`](/block-editor/reference-guides/block-api/block-context/) properties in block.json._

**Uses context:**

- `postType`

## Block Markup

This is a [**dynamic block**](/block-editor/getting-started/fundamentals/static-dynamic-rendering/). It is rendered on the server and does not save HTML in post content.

In post content, it is stored as a block comment:

```html
<!-- wp:post-navigation-link {"type":"next","showTitle":false,"linkLabel":false,"arrow":"none","taxonomy":""} /-->
```
